name: multisession
description: Agent-to-agent work between Claude Code sessions. spawn-fresh: open a new Konsole tab, launch a new named Claude session (claude --name/--session-id) and hand it the next task over SendMessage, for a clean context. handover: pass this session's work to another running session with the built-in SendMessage, leave the payload in an agent-to-agent space (a local folder, or a Google Drive folder for agents on other machines), and close this session's own Konsole pane. send/inbox: asynchronous messages written into another repo's a2a/ folder, with SessionStart pickup, reminders and living messages. Breakout (an idea that needs its own repo) is a message kind.
